content.description: Griffin is an API-first BaaS platform. As a prominent player in the Infrastructure Tools space, Griffin specializes in delivering high-quality decentralized computing tools infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Solana and Ethereum, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Griffin focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
